target: unconditional four-dimensional Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
public_move: Promote a bounded Wilson-network algebraic reconstruction and spectral statement as completion of the full target.
observable_failure: Infinite-volume reconstruction, continuum locality, reflection positivity and the contracted mass-gap statement were not all descendants of the proved nodes.
minimal_check: Write the Clay target and the proved bounded-network theorem side by side and compare objects, quantifiers and limits.
repair: Keep the bounded theorem as a separate proved node; create explicit UV, infinite-volume, locality, reconstruction and spectral-gap bridge nodes.
outcome: The completion claim was retracted while the algebraic construction remained a usable conditional component.
reusable_policy: A finite-volume or truncated theorem never inherits a continuum universal claim without named bridge nodes.

public_move: Extend a symmetric or saturated component-gluing theorem to an arbitrary near-peripheral rooted tree.
observable_failure: The route still required the universal existence of a compatible nonuniform component decomposition.
minimal_check: Isolate the statement 'every near-peripheral rooted tree reaches a compatible component-layer state' as a standalone quantified claim.
repair: Record the star, Toeplitz and pendant-completion families as proved infinite subclasses and leave the universal reachability node open.
outcome: Several new infinite families and exact obstruction identities were retained without claiming the full conjecture.
reusable_policy: A large constructive family is progress only on the weighted dependency graph; it is not the missing universal quantifier.

target: general component gluing for graceful trees
public_move: Replace pair symmetry by a Toeplitz displacement profile and affine saturation.
observable_failure: Earlier symmetric-star assumptions did not cover arbitrary ordered bilabeled components with holes.
minimal_check: Remove symmetry and monotonicity from the profile and ask whether the permutation displacement certificate still exists.
repair: Separate the exact Toeplitz-X-ray equivalence, affine saturation theorem and the remaining arbitrary-component layer obligation.
outcome: The revised mechanism closed a strictly larger asymmetric family and exposed the exact residual obligation.
reusable_policy: When a construction succeeds by symmetry, identify the invariant certificate and test whether symmetry is merely sufficient or logically necessary.

target: 142 points in the 71 by 71 grid with no three collinear
public_move: Use exact UNSAT and transversal bounds around a named eight-defect seed as evidence of global completion.
observable_failure: The exact results only excluded specified neighborhoods; no valid 142-point coordinate certificate existed and the global construction remained open.
minimal_check: Run the independent three-collinearity verifier on the alleged final coordinate set and require exactly two points in every row and column.
repair: State local UNSAT and conflict-hypergraph transversal results as local theorems; retain the global certificate obligation as OPEN.
outcome: A strict local lower bound and several exact neighborhood exclusions were preserved without a false construction claim.
reusable_policy: Local exact UNSAT is a theorem about its frozen model, not about the global search space.

public_move: State an equivalence after proving only one implication and use an undeclared linearity property in the reverse direction.
observable_failure: The reverse implication and higher-order remainder control did not follow from the published assumptions.
minimal_check: Mark the first proof line using linearity, uniformity or a two-sided inverse and compare it with the theorem statement.
repair: Downgrade iff to the proved direction or add the missing hypotheses; expose remainder estimates as separate lemmas.
outcome: The main chain was retained after removing the invalid mixed high-low normal-form route and repairing theorem statements.
reusable_policy: Every property first used in a proof must appear in the theorem input or be proved from it.

target: whether completion preserves continuous inverse algebras
public_move: Use a dense nil subalgebra inside a semisimple Banach algebra to construct a noncomplete CIA whose completion is not a CIA.
observable_failure: The first sketch risked treating density and pointwise nilpotence as automatically sufficient for all CIA axioms.
minimal_check: Verify inversion on the unitization of the algebraic direct sum and exhibit a specific completion element at which invertibility/openness fails.
repair: Split the construction into algebra definition, CIA verification before completion, completion identification and explicit non-CIA witness.
outcome: The route produced a closed counterexample manuscript after the four dependencies were audited separately.
reusable_policy: A counterexample succeeds only when both the source object satisfies every hypothesis and the target failure has an explicit witness.

target: whether every Banach-Lie subgroup is initial
public_move: Use the dense range of a compact injective diagonal operator in an additive Hilbert-Lie group.
observable_failure: An early argument mixed historical strong initiality with the weaker current initial universal property.
minimal_check: Pin the monograph definition and test the example against that exact mapping universal property, not tangent injectivity alone.
repair: Prove the sigma-compact closure obstruction under the weak current definition and then derive the Hilbert-space example.
outcome: The revised theorem failed even the weakest relevant initiality notion and yielded a stronger general corollary.
reusable_policy: Before claiming a counterexample, version the definition and prove failure of that exact version.

target: uniqueness in Lie III for simply connected analytic groups
public_move: Construct two analytic group laws on E times C using an entire E-valued cocycle with the same topological Lie algebra.
observable_failure: The strongest desired 'complete model-space' version still required a complete locally convex model and a fully checked analytic cocycle range.
minimal_check: List completeness of E, analyticity of multiplication/inversion, simple connectivity and exact Lie algebra identification as independent nodes.
repair: Retain the noncomplete analytic example and block the stronger complete-model claim until all model-space nodes close.
outcome: A precise boundary between the closed example and the stronger requested theorem was established.
reusable_policy: Do not transfer a pathology across completion without rechecking every analytic and infinitesimal structure.

target: Kaplansky direct finiteness for group algebras
public_move: Lift non-directly-finite Leavitt algebra elements through a surjective group-algebra quotient.
observable_failure: Surjectivity and a non-directly-finite quotient do not produce yx=1 and xy not equal 1 in the source algebra.
minimal_check: Write the exact corner equation yx=f, xy not equal f in f k[G] f and attempt to solve it without passing to the quotient.
repair: Promote the quotient lifting and corner compression as proved reductions; leave the corner equation as the single load-bearing open node.
outcome: The false completion claim was avoided and the remaining obstruction was compressed to one exact equation.
reusable_policy: A quotient counterexample does not lift through a noninjective map unless the defective identities themselves are solved upstairs.

target: time-renormalization convolution operator with Rota-Baxter-type identity
public_move: Apply a Hopf-type Rota-Baxter identity without preserving the cocommutativity condition under which the convolution rearrangement was derived.
observable_failure: The proof permuted coproduct legs in a noncocommutative setting.
minimal_check: Annotate every use of Sweedler indices and mark where a tensor-leg exchange occurs.
repair: State the theorem for cocommutative Hopf algebras and keep noncocommutative generalization as a separate braided/ordered problem.
outcome: The valid weight-one construction on the declared class was retained; unrelated Rota-Baxter material was removed from the main application line.
reusable_policy: A tensor-leg permutation is an assumption, not notation.

public_move: Tune tens of thousands of configurations and interpret a high inner score as identified geometry.
observable_failure: Winner's curse, homolog/source leakage and feature overlap with the baseline could explain the apparent gain.
minimal_check: Freeze source-homology groups, generate every query feature independently of the query set and evaluate only outer out-of-fold predictions.
repair: Use nested group OOF, immutable folds/hashes, one-standard-error selection, query-set isolation and group-level bootstrap.
outcome: The theory was revised from unrecognized manifold objects to signals supported by leakage-audited data and explicit OOD rejection.
reusable_policy: In small data, the train-test construction is part of the theorem; a score without isolation is not evidence.

public_move: Treat quantum-group ultraviolet suppression as if it automatically implied locality, reflection positivity, continuum reconstruction and a mass gap.
observable_failure: The abstract UV mechanism did not supply the downstream axioms or infrared spectral theorem.
minimal_check: Delete the quantum-group vocabulary and identify the exact estimate or universal property lost at each bridge.
repair: Require every new structure to close a named claim, produce a checkable estimate or generate a falsifiable model prediction.
outcome: The quantum-group construction was retained as a candidate UV component rather than declared a complete Yang-Mills solution.
reusable_policy: Advanced language enters the proof DAG only when removing it breaks an explicit derivation.

target: unstable motivic nearby cycles and tame Milnor fibers
public_move: Generalize a stable nearby-cycle formalism while allowing unrelated extensions to enter the manuscript.
observable_failure: The target requested only the unstable nearby-cycle/Milnor-fiber bridge; broader claims diluted the dependency chain and introduced unverified functoriality.
minimal_check: For each section ask whether it defines or proves a node on i-star j-star / path-space to tame Milnor fiber.
repair: Delete unrelated structures, version the path-space construction and state each unstable comparison with exact hypotheses.
outcome: The manuscript was narrowed to the requested bridge with clearer definitions and source dependencies.
reusable_policy: Research breadth is not progress when it does not lie in the target ancestor closure.

public_move: Report 82 or 87 percent weighted dependency completion in a way that could be read as theorem probability or final-certificate completion.
observable_failure: The target node remained open and acceptance records were zero despite many audited subresults.
minimal_check: Display target logical closure 0/1, release state, open critical obligations and current certificate beside the percentage.
repair: Define percentage only as weighted proof-research dependency completion and never as probability, coverage of instances or time estimate.
outcome: Harness reports could preserve valuable partial theorems while stating BLOCKED_EXACT without ambiguity.
reusable_policy: Every progress metric must carry its semantics and cannot override the theorem state machine.

target: auditable exact construction or UNSAT theorem
public_move: Use a generator and verifier that share parsing, normalization or core solver code.
observable_failure: A common implementation error could make both components accept the same false certificate.
minimal_check: Reconstruct from the raw instance with a different algorithm and run label, edge, sign, rank, parameter and digest tamper classes.
repair: Assign independence groups, require two groups for critical nodes and preserve every rejected tamper artifact.
outcome: Exact GTC and grid-search subresults gained cold-replay and mutation-resistance contracts.
reusable_policy: Two executions are not two audits when they share the same failure mode.
